notes.title: Major Update and New Game Release!
notes.content:
Hi, everyone, GuiltyEva here.

Since the launch of the game in 2021, I've been gathering info from the players and thinking of ways to make the game better and more enjoyable.

An [b]Easy Mode[/b] was frequently asked, so HERE IT IS. 
The controls were sturdy, and players asked for [b]more fluidity[/b], so HERE IT IS.
Players were unhappy with the randomness of the pieces, so [b]the system was improved[/b] and HERE IT IS.
People asked for a way to secure a piece for the next round, and HERE IT IS THE [b]BREAK COMMAND[/b].
[b]Minor and obscure[/b] gameplay bugs have been reported, and the fixes ARE HERE.

All of this are here to celebrate the sequel: HARD BLOCK GIRLS - SEX LIFE
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40199670/9c31bbe0509b8aea64943f5b7026ea585136b041.png[/img]

[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1960970/Hard_Block_Girls_Sex_Life/]Check the page here[/url]

Launch: 05/11

I heavily suggest you to play the updated version with Easy mode, better controls, new BREAK feature and overaal better experience to finish all the levels and reveal the great art of the girls. All of that will be also on HBG-Sex Life too.

notes.title: Upcoming Update and a New Game is Available!
notes.content:
Hi, everyone, GuiltyEva here.

Happy to announce that an [i]Easy Mode[/i] is being developed and will appear on the next update, a couple weeks from now. The difficulty of the game was very criticized and I am glad an alternative way of play is finnaly coming for you, the players.

Other great news is that I'm presenting the HBG beauties on my new game, [b]Jigsaw Pink[/b].
It's a SFW casual game of Jigsaw Puzzles featuring the ~non naughty~ art of Hard Block Girls. If you guys are into this type of game, or want to show support, please buy the game and don't miss the launch discount.

[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1898990/Jigsaw_Pink/]Buy Jigsaw Pink![/url]

notes.title: Update Released!
notes.content:
A new feature was added to the gameplay!

With this update, you have access to:

[olist]
[*] New achievements.
[*] Control now with Backspace and WASD or arrows.
[*] Minor bugs fixed.
[*] Use of the SHAKE feature, that can make blocks fall.
[/olist]

I hope you enjoy!
